author: GamingBolt
description:
Investigation takes a backseat in favour of survival horror in The Sinking City 2, a sequel set to ramp up the tension of its predecessor with a string of gameplay and mechanical innovations. 

Yet, while we’ve already explored these gameplay differences and finer details in separate features, there’s still plenty of useful information you should know before diving into its flooded vision. 

From optional content and Kickstarter stretch goals, to returning locations, edition bonuses, and accessibility options, here are fifteen more things you need to know before buying The Sinking City 2.
title: The Sinking City 2 - 15 Details You Absolutely Need To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
The last two patches for Crimson Desert have been a bit on the quiet side in terms of content, adding cross-save and fixing several bugs. Which is perfectly fine – the development team doesn't always have to drop massive overhauls, dozens of new armor sets, and so on. What's next, anyway? A complete overhaul of the trading system?

title: Crimson Desert Is On A ROLL - 10 More NEW Changes You Need to Know
